summary: 30 Cookies is just 4 batches (4 Flour, 8 Eggs, 4 Sticks), and the two Chicken Coops already lay. The critical path is Wheat: it takes 12 days to grow, so the Clay Pit, Farm and Wheat tiles come first, then the Windmill and the Cookie Shop's bricks while it grows.

build_order.note: 8 Bricks + 3 Planks; 1 Flour + 2 Eggs + 1 Stick makes 8 Cookies.
Optional 10 Beer: 2 Wheat + 2 Sticks with 15 Planks + 4 Stone; plant extra Wheat.

pitfalls: Delaying the Wheat by a few days delays the whole level by the same amount.
Ten Eggs start in stock and Eggs are not eaten, so the coops (about 5 a day each) only need to top up for the eight required.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
